question: What duration and intensity of austerity removes the pair of sins?
premises: Fierce austerity must be performed for a certain duration
At the end of that austerity a pair of sins is addressed
inference: Performing fierce austerity until its completion leads to the removal of two sins
uncertainties: The exact referent of the pair of sins is not explicit in this verse
